changeSet.author: josh

and.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'operating_hour_slot' AND column_name IN ('from_time', 'to_time') AND (udt_name = 'timetz' OR data_type = 'time with time zone')

changeSet.comment: Update operating_hour_slot table to support timezone-aware time fields for UTC implementation. Convert from_time and to_time from VARCHAR(255) to TIMETZ (UTC) to match OffsetTime Java type in DTOs and entities.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE operating_hour_slot SET from_time = NULL WHERE from_time IS NOT NULL AND trim(from_time) != '' AND trim(from_time) !~ '^[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?([+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2}|Z)?$';

ALTER TABLE operating_hour_slot ALTER COLUMN from_time TYPE timetz USING ( CASE WHEN from_time IS NULL OR trim(from_time) = '' THEN NULL -- If already has timezone, parse directly WHEN trim(from_time) ~ '[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2}|Z$' THEN CASE WHEN trim(from_time) ~ 'Z$' THEN replace(trim(from_time), 'Z', '+00')::timetz ELSE trim(from_time)::timetz END -- Otherwise, parse as TIME first, then convert to TIMETZ with UTC ELSE (trim(from_time)::time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::timetz END );
UPDATE operating_hour_slot SET to_time = NULL WHERE to_time IS NOT NULL AND trim(to_time) != '' AND trim(to_time) !~ '^[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?([+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2}|Z)?$';

ALTER TABLE operating_hour_slot ALTER COLUMN to_time TYPE timetz USING ( CASE WHEN to_time IS NULL OR trim(to_time) = '' THEN NULL -- If already has timezone, parse directly WHEN trim(to_time) ~ '[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2}|Z$' THEN CASE WHEN trim(to_time) ~ 'Z$' THEN replace(trim(to_time), 'Z', '+00')::timetz ELSE trim(to_time)::timetz END -- Otherwise, parse as TIME first, then convert to TIMETZ with UTC ELSE (trim(to_time)::time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::timetz END );

COMMENT ON COLUMN operating_hour_slot.from_time IS 'Operating hour slot start time in UTC (format: HH:MM:SS+00)'; COMMENT ON COLUMN operating_hour_slot.to_time IS 'Operating hour slot end time in UTC (format: HH:MM:SS+00)';

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE operating_hour_slot ALTER COLUMN from_time TYPE character varying(255) USING ( CASE WHEN from_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(from_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') END ), ALTER COLUMN to_time TYPE character varying(255) USING ( CASE WHEN to_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_char(to_time::time, 'HH24:MI:SS') END );
COMMENT ON COLUMN operating_hour_slot.from_time IS NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN operating_hour_slot.to_time IS NULL;
